U.note: Clear two-color ratio mixer comparing sRGB mean with linear light, keyboard shortcuts and copy, but the ASCII is a tiny dull block and the page is sparse.

V.note: Drop-ink field with light/paint models and per-cell readout is seeded with a striking mix, themed, and works well on mobile.

W.note: Paint-the-canvas mixer with ramps and modes is feature-rich, but it opens as a black void with a mismatched white panel area and nothing to see until you drag.

X.note: Three draggable color sources with amounts and Light/Paint/Naive models fill the ASCII field with a live blended gradient and a probe readout, with a good mobile layout.

Y.note: Ink mixer with a live ASCII swatch and paint canvas, but the canvas starts blank black, the layout leaves dead space, and controls are busy.

Z.note: Elegant two-color sphere rendered in ASCII with a ratio strip, models and keyboard control; the controls fall below the fold on desktop but it stays focused and polished.
